lemmas.primary_translation: an exclamation of amazement, surprise, or dismay

definitions.text: brukt for å uttrykke overveldelse, overraskelse, forferdelse eller lignende
definitions.translation: used to express being overwhelmed, surprise, horror, or the like (lit. oh, woe is me!)

examples.no: å jøye meg, nå går det galt!
examples.en: Oh, woe is me, now it is going wrong!
